cells.gaps: No share of centres registering in the software is given. ONECI's 298 centres connected to City Web for registering events (CIV-042, July 2024) come with no total, and every other offices figure is of centres equipped, computerised, connected or deployed (43.8% deployed and 346 of 690 connected, 50.1%, in July and August 2024; more than 84% covered on 16 September 2025; 98% on 2 March 2026 with no numerator or denominator; 699 centres on 11 August 2026 with no total; all centres on 23 October 2026, with connectivity still a problem). How the record is made is disputed: ONECI's 2024 statements say connected, the World Bank's newer one of 18 September 2025 says the registry is still on paper, and the newer stands. The SNECI is given no period and is not said to name the software, and the 2026 finance law's domestic line names no system.
cells.note: Stage 3 on the study's rule that a share of offices equipped places there; the October 2026 statement that the software is deployed in all centres is also a share equipped. Not 4: no share of offices registering is given, and the newest fact on how the record is made says paper.
